gloss: the strongest person; the most powerful

definitions.gloss: the strongest person; the most powerful individual
definitions.explanation: The person who is the strongest or most powerful in a given group, field, or competition. Frequently used in gaming, martial arts, sports, and fiction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is the strongest in this tournament.

examples.japanese: {最強者|さいきょうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦トーナメント→トーナメント：08408_toonamento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The tournament to decide the strongest has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴代|れきだい}→歴代：13199_rekidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一堂|いちどう}→一堂：11383_ichidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{会|かい}する⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a dream-like tournament where the strongest competitors of all time gathered in one place.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{最強|さいきょう}→最強：13073_saikyou⟧ (strongest) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). This word is heavily used in competitive and entertainment contexts: fighting games, anime, martial arts, and sports discussions.

The concept of {最強者|さいきょうしゃ} is a recurring theme in Japanese popular culture, from battle manga to competitive gaming. Characters described as the {最強者|さいきょうしゃ} often serve as the ultimate challenge or final boss.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最強者|さいきょうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to determine the strongest
- ⟦{歴代|れきだい}→歴代：13199_rekidai⟧{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}: the strongest of all time
- ⟦{真|しん}→真：28884_shin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}: the true strongest
- {最強者|さいきょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧: to challenge the strongest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最強|さいきょう}→最強：13073_saikyou⟧: strongest — the adjective/noun without the person suffix
- ⟦{王者|おうじゃ}→王者：13539_ouja⟧: champion, champion title holder — emphasizes holding a title or throne
- ⟦{覇者|はしゃ}→覇者：24558_hasha⟧: champion, victor — emphasizes dominance through winning a competition
- ⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧: master, expert — emphasizes skill and mastery rather than raw power
